title: Turning uncertainty into opportunity
titleChinese: 如何化不确定性为机遇
paragraphs: Starting a new job, moving house, quitting your job to start a new business – all of these can be great opportunities, but all of them can lead to uncertainty. We can't know for sure that they will turn out well. Could this fear of the unknown be holding us back?

Improving things in your life often requires some uncertainty, whether that's making time to learn something new, or moving to a new area. And it's not just about radical change. We often make negative assumptions about people we don't know, but if we go through the uncertainty of getting to know someone new, we can establish positive social or working relationships.

So, how can we learn to make the most of uncertainty? First, it can help to adjust the way we think about not knowing what will happen. Being curious about a new job can help us grow, while being afraid of any negative changes can stop us taking advantage of new opportunities. It can be helpful to see threats as challenges that can be overcome.

One thing that can help with this is having faith in your own abilities. When assessing an uncertain future situation, consider your own capability in being able to mitigate any issues that come up. If you know that you have the skills, knowledge or flexibility required to address unforeseen problems, then uncertainty can seem like less of a threat.

Believing in yourself is one way to build resilience. E-commerce entrepreneur Alexandre Bonvin highlights the importance of building up a cash buffer in business. Another way to build your resilience can be to take on small tasks that have some uncertainty and reflecting on how you deal with each one.
A positive mindset and building up our own personal resilience can help us use uncertainty as an opportunity for growth.

vocabulary.example: There is a great deal of uncertainty about the future.

vocabulary.entry: **hold back** /ˌhəʊld ˈbæk/ phr. v. 阻碍，阻止（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: Fear can hold you back from achieving your goals.
vocabulary.translation: 恐惧会阻碍你实现目标。

vocabulary.entry: **radical** /ˈrædɪkl/ adj. 彻底的，根本的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: The company needs to make radical changes.
vocabulary.translation: 公司需要进行彻底的变革。

vocabulary.example: The study is based on the assumption that people are rational.
vocabulary.translation: 这项研究基于人们是理性的这一假设。

vocabulary.example: They established a successful business together.
vocabulary.translation: 他们一起建立了一家成功的企业。

vocabulary.entry: **curious** /ˈkjʊəriəs/ adj. 好奇的，求知欲强的
vocabulary.example: Children are naturally curious about the world.
vocabulary.translation: 孩子们天生对世界充满好奇。

vocabulary.example: Climate change poses a serious threat to coastal cities.
vocabulary.translation: 气候变化对沿海城市构成了严重威胁。

vocabulary.example: She managed to overcome her fear of flying.
vocabulary.translation: 她设法克服了对飞行的恐惧。

vocabulary.example: The test assesses your language skills.
vocabulary.translation: 这项测试评估你的语言技能。

vocabulary.example: The company has the capability to produce high-quality goods.
vocabulary.translation: 该公司有能力生产高质量的产品。

vocabulary.example: Measures were taken to mitigate the effects of the flood.
vocabulary.translation: 已采取措施减轻洪水的影响。

vocabulary.entry: **flexibility** /ˌfleksəˈbɪləti/ n. 灵活性，弹性（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Stretching exercises improve your flexibility.
vocabulary.translation: 伸展运动能提高你的柔韧性。

vocabulary.entry: **unforeseen** /ˌʌnfɔːˈsiːn/ adj. 未预见到的，意外的（书面语）
vocabulary.example: Unforeseen problems delayed the project.
vocabulary.translation: 未预见的问题延误了项目。

vocabulary.entry: **resilience** /rɪˈzɪliəns/ n. 韧性，复原力（书面语）
vocabulary.example: She showed great resilience in the face of adversity.
vocabulary.translation: 她在逆境中表现出极大的韧性。

vocabulary.entry: **e-commerce** /ˈiː kɒmɜːs/ n. 电子商务（专业术语）
vocabulary.example: E-commerce has changed the way people shop.
vocabulary.translation: 电子商务改变了人们的购物方式。

vocabulary.example: He is a successful young entrepreneur who started his own business.
vocabulary.translation: 他是一位成功的年轻企业家，创办了自己的公司。

vocabulary.entry: **cash buffer** /ˈkæʃ ˌbʌfə(r)/ n. 现金缓冲（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: A cash buffer can help a business survive tough times.
vocabulary.translation: 现金缓冲可以帮助企业度过艰难时期。

vocabulary.entry: **take on** /ˌteɪk ˈɒn/ phr. v. 承担（工作或责任）（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: She took on the challenge of learning a new language.
vocabulary.translation: 她承担了学习一门新语言的挑战。

vocabulary.entry: **reflect on** /rɪˈflekt ɒn/ phr. v. 反思，思考（固定表达）
vocabulary.example: Take time to reflect on your achievements.
vocabulary.translation: 花时间反思你的成就。

vocabulary.entry: **mindset** /ˈmaɪndset/ n. 思维模式，心态（书面语）
vocabulary.example: A positive mindset can improve your health.
vocabulary.translation: 积极的心态可以改善你的健康。

vocabulary.example: This is a great opportunity to learn new skills.
vocabulary.translation: 这是学习新技能的好机会。

vocabulary.example: Personal growth is a lifelong process.
vocabulary.translation: 个人成长是一个终生的过程。

vocabulary.entry: **curious** /ˈkjʊəriəs/ adj. 好奇的，求知欲强的

vocabulary.translation: 我对这台机器的工作原理很好奇。

vocabulary.translation: 她有出色的领导技能。

vocabulary.translation: 他的历史知识令人印象深刻。

sentences.english: Starting a new job, moving house, quitting your job to start a new business – all of these can be great opportunities, but all of them can lead to uncertainty.
sentences.chinese: 开始新工作、搬家、辞职创业——这些都是很好的机会，但它们都可能带来不确定性。

sentences.english: We can't know for sure that they will turn out well.
sentences.chinese: 我们无法确定它们会发展得很好。

sentences.english: Could this fear of the unknown be holding us back?
sentences.chinese: 这种对未知的恐惧会不会阻碍我们前进呢？

sentences.english: Improving things in your life often requires some uncertainty, whether that's making time to learn something new, or moving to a new area.
sentences.chinese: 改善生活中的事情往往需要一些不确定性，无论是挤出时间学习新东西，还是搬到新的地区。

sentences.english: And it's not just about radical change.
sentences.chinese: 这不仅仅关乎彻底的改变。

sentences.english: We often make negative assumptions about people we don't know, but if we go through the uncertainty of getting to know someone new, we can establish positive social or working relationships.
sentences.chinese: 我们常常对不认识的人做出消极的假设，但如果我们经历过了解新人的不确定性，就可以建立积极的社交或工作关系。

sentences.english: So, how can we learn to make the most of uncertainty?
sentences.chinese: 那么，我们如何学会充分利用不确定性呢？

sentences.english: First, it can help to adjust the way we think about not knowing what will happen.
sentences.chinese: 首先，调整我们对未知结果的思考方式会有所帮助。

sentences.english: Being curious about a new job can help us grow, while being afraid of any negative changes can stop us taking advantage of new opportunities.
sentences.chinese: 对新工作保持好奇可以帮助我们成长，而对任何负面变化的恐惧则会阻止我们利用新的机会。

sentences.english: It can be helpful to see threats as challenges that can be overcome.
sentences.chinese: 将威胁视为可以克服的挑战对我们大有益处。

sentences.english: One thing that can help with this is having faith in your own abilities.
sentences.chinese: 有件事可以对此有帮助，就是相信自己的能力。

sentences.english: When assessing an uncertain future situation, consider your own capability in being able to mitigate any issues that come up.
sentences.chinese: 在评估不确定的未来情况时，要考虑自己是否有能力应对出现的任何问题。

sentences.english: If you know that you have the skills, knowledge or flexibility required to address unforeseen problems, then uncertainty can seem like less of a threat.
sentences.chinese: 如果你知道自己拥有解决不可预见问题所需的技能、知识或灵活性，那么不确定性似乎就不那么具有威胁了。

sentences.english: Believing in yourself is one way to build resilience.
sentences.chinese: 相信自己是一种建立适应力的方式。

sentences.english: E-commerce entrepreneur Alexandre Bonvin highlights the importance of building up a cash buffer in business.
sentences.chinese: 电子商务企业家亚历山大·邦万强调了在企业中建立现金缓冲的重要性。

sentences.english: Another way to build your resilience can be to take on small tasks that have some uncertainty and reflecting on how you deal with each one.
sentences.chinese: 另一种建立韧性的方法是承担一些具有不确定性的小任务，并反思你如何应对每一个任务。

sentences.english: A positive mindset and building up our own personal resilience can help us use uncertainty as an opportunity for growth.
sentences.chinese: 积极的心态和建立我们自己的韧性可以帮助我们将不确定性作为成长的机会。
